g.text: One genuine arch / complete mineral face and intrados wrap
2960rough →2400finished · root-directed joined development · no arch/support/material/thermal certification
The separate weatherleaf arch is replaced locally;240glass+40lining cannot occupy the same volume as brick.
Wrap customcuts120radial layers from thickerbarecore stock; ≤500chord sagitta≈16.65, no flat600tile shortcut.
Weatherarch/cavity are locally rewound; ordinary429.5shell and new519.5sidewalls are otherwise unchanged.
No bareglass carries masonry. The rawopening/abutment geometry must earn fullbearing, not landpartlyon insulation.
